name: jlcpcb
title: JLCPCB standard SMT assembly: part spacing, edge keep-outs, fiducials and rails
notes: spacing_mm: JLCPCB's recommended minimum spacing by package pair (symmetric). Its page does not say which edges the distances are measured between (the drawing is an image); dfa.py measures pad copper to pad copper, at least as strict as body to body for chips and leaded parts.

Chips larger than 1206 use the 1206 row (the table stops there). Packages not in the table (connectors, through-hole, electrolytics, inductors in their own packages) are not checked; dfa.py lists them.
Edge keep-out for brittle parts (MLCCs, crystals, BGAs): 3-5 mm from board edges and V-cut lines is 'safe' (depaneling stress); 3 mm is used.

Edge rails (at least 5 mm) and fiducials are required for standard assembly. Fiducials: bare 1 mm copper pad, 2 mm mask opening, 3 to 4 along the edges, at least 3.35 mm from the edge including the keep-out.
Orientation: polarized parts one way (e.g. all north or west), IC pin 1 in the same corner, to simplify inspection.
